healthIntro.title: Health Insurance
healthIntro.description: Even if you have other health insurance, you may still qualify for Medicaid. We ask about your current coverage to coordinate benefits and make sure you get the right coverage.
healthIntro.infoNote: We'll ask about health insurance for each person in your household.
healthIntro.faqQuestion: Why does Medicaid ask about other insurance?
healthIntro.faqAnswer: Medicaid is often the "payer of last resort," meaning it covers costs after other insurance pays first. Knowing about your existing coverage helps State-X HHS coordinate benefits properly and avoid duplicate payments.

healthInsurance.title: Current Health Insurance
healthInsurance.subtitle: Tell us about any health coverage this person currently has or recently lost.
healthInsurance.gatingQuestion: Does this person have health insurance?
healthInsurance.differentHolderQuestion: Is someone else the policy holder? *
healthInsurance.premiumNote: Enter the amount deducted from paychecks or paid directly
healthInsurance.lostCoverageInfo: You may qualify for a Special Enrollment Period or retroactive Medicaid coverage. We'll check eligibility based on your loss date.

employerCoverage.title: Employer-Offered Insurance
employerCoverage.gatingQuestion: Is anyone in your household offered health insurance through their employer, even if they haven't enrolled?
